transfer_blockers_or_work: PHYSICAL SAFETY: this checkpoint trained with bus.write_speed=4096, bus.write_acc=1000 and safety.max_delta_q_deg=3.6 (360 deg/s per-tick cap) -- the SIM TRAINING contract, not a physical-safe contract. Other exported policies on this project (e.g. walk_allheading_mlp_singleframe_acq1_stdanneal) use bus_write_speed=400/write_acc=20 and max_delta_q_deg=0.375 (37.5 deg/s). Robot Lab MUST independently verify/derate these against real servo/current limits before ANY motion; do not run the exported JSON's contract values as-is. This is flagged in the exported JSON's own meta.PHYSICAL_SAFETY_CAUTION field so it travels with the artifact.

KNOWN BEHAVIORAL LIMITATION: a SUSTAINED (~15 s) off-forward heading (approx +-90/+-135/180 deg) chronically sacrifices one front leg's swing (root-caused as a policy/exploration gap, not a kinematic ceiling; a fix -- heading self-distillation -- is in flight, not yet landed). Forward and brief-transition headings are clean on video (0 falls, gait_valid=true, sacrificed_legs=[] for the full 26 s captures). RECOMMEND: restrict the first physical trial's command envelope to forward + brief (<5 s) turns/diagonals until this is resolved, per the demo evidence actually shown.
Run only the read-only hardware preflight first: 18 servos, IMU, pose near walk_ready, tilt within limit (same preflight class as other exported-policy handoffs).

Joystick commands must stay inside the trained command envelope (0.06 m/s, the 8-way heading set above) until a hardware ladder says otherwise -- this checkpoint was never trained on continuous/arbitrary yaw rates.
Stop immediately on tip, brownout, high current, missing servo, or hot motor.
